$comment: x-version matches the protocol version at the top of https://wod.imav8n.com/AGENT.md; its changelog says what changed.
title: WODin workout result
description: What the athlete actually did, produced by the page and read by an agent. Pairs with a plan (wod.schema.json) via workoutId.

duration.description: Total session time as mm:ss or h:mm:ss, from the page timer or typed by hand. Null if never started.

durationSec.description: Same value in seconds, so consumers need not parse.

rpe.description: The athlete's own answer. Null means they left it blank — never the plan's targetRpe, which is only ever shown as a ghost hint.

athleteSummary.description: Free text on how the session went. Null if left blank.

log.description: Every set that was not skipped, keyed "<exerciseId>.<setId>" — including sets done exactly as prescribed, which carry asPlanned: true. A set missing from here was either skipped or belongs to a skipped exercise; absence never means "done as planned".

notes.description: Athlete notes, keyed by exercise id — one per exercise, never per set. Only exercises with a non-empty note appear.

exerciseRpe.description: How hard each movement felt, keyed by exercise id, 1–10. Separate from the session-level `rpe`: a workout can average out at 7 while one lift was a 9, and that difference is what tells you which movement to move next time. Only exercises the athlete actually rated appear — an absent key means unrated, never easy.

scores.description: One score per scored section (a section with a scheme), keyed by section id. A for_time section gives { time, timeSec }, or { capped: true, rounds, reps } when the cap was hit; an amrap gives { rounds, reps }. Only sections the athlete entered a score for appear — an absent key means unanswered or skipped, never zero. The section's exercises still log round by round in log, round K under set K.

skipped.description: Exercise ids the athlete marked Skip. Their sets are absent from log.

planHash.description: Optional digest of the plan this was logged against, so an agent can tell whether the plan changed underneath.

entry.description: One logged set. Which fields are present follows the exercise's kind.

load.description: Number in the plan's load unit. A string only when the athlete typed something non-numeric.

loadType.description: Present instead of load for unweighted or banded work. band-assist means the band helped; a lighter one is progress.

band.description: The band level actually used, with loadType band or band-assist. Compared against the plan's band for asPlanned.

added.description: True for a set the athlete added beyond the prescription. Such sets are always asPlanned: false.

asPlanned.description: True when every logged value matches the prescription for this set. The cheap read on compliance — filter for false to see where the session diverged.
